cache_limitations: First recorded launch per input/format, not a cold-cache claim; validation already touched inputs. No cache flush, affinity or exclusive-host claim.
timing_method: perf_counter before Popen through communicate; startup, read, analysis, render and pipe-byte capture included. Evidence hashing/persistence happens afterward.
rss_method: Maximum observed live OS PeakWorkingSetSize across launcher/interpreter descendants; requested 1ms waits, descendants discovered every 20ms. Also records maximum simultaneous tree WorkingSetSize. Late peaks/brief descendants may be missed; monitor overhead included; parent capture buffers excluded.
wmi_access: Not queried; CPU registry and native memory API used instead
